verdict.rationale: mise's security docs say Cosign/Minisign signatures, SLSA provenance and GitHub artifact attestations are verified automatically by its built-in implementation, but this is scoped to aqua tools. The http backend also accepts a sha256 checksum in config. Verification for the other backends (npm, pipx, github, asdf/vfox plugins) is not documented, and nothing shows whether a failed check blocks execution. missing for 10: documented verification across all backends, explicit failure/blocking behavior on mismatch, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can trust that fetched packages are verified against checksums, signatures, or attestations before they run

citations.quote: For aqua tools, Cosign/Minisign signatures, SLSA provenance, and GitHub artifact attestations are verified automatically using mise's built-in implementation.
mise has built-in support for Cosign and Minisign signatures, SLSA provenance, and GitHub artifact attestations.
